description.value: Avalanche Pizza is a fast-food pizza restaurant located in Whistler, BC, serving the Gateway Drive area of the resort community. As a fast-food outlet in one of BC's premier cycling destinations, it would likely be a convenient refuelling stop for riders passing through Whistler. Its current operational status and on-site amenities could not be verified due to a compromised website.
